title: Events — Utsah Events | Bardoli, Gujarat
description: Explore Utsah Events — weddings, corporate events, and live celebrations crafted with passion in Bardoli, Gujarat.
headExtra:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,300;1,400;1,600&family=Cinzel:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=DM+Sans:wght@200;300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/style.css?v=87">
<style>
    .events-page { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
    .nav__logo { cursor: pointer; }
    /* Maroon logo */
    .nav__logo-img { filter: sepia(1) hue-rotate(-45deg) saturate(6) brightness(0.55) !important; }
    @media (min-width: 431px) {
      #nav { transition: opacity 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) !important; }
      #dropdownBtn { transition: opacity 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 430px) {
      .nav { pointer-events: all !important; }
      .nav__logo { pointer-events: all !important; display: block; }
    }

    /* HERO — full screen, text only */
    .events-hero {
      height: 100vh;
      min-height: unset;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 120px 24px 100px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .events-hero__bottom {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 32px;
      left: 0; right: 0;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    /* SECTION 2 — cycling card */
    .events-categories {
      padding: 24px 20px 32px;
    }
    .cat-single {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 20px;
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      max-width: 480px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .events-hero__label {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #FFD700;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .events-hero__title {
      font-family: 'Cinzel', serif;
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 6.5vw, 5.5rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      line-height: 1.0;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    /* Desktop only — matches the Times New Roman treatment on the home
       hero. Scoped above the tablet breakpoint so phone/tablet keep
       their existing Cinzel untouched. */
    @media (min-width: 1025px) {
      .events-hero__title { font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; }
    }
    .events-hero__title span { color: var(--maroon); }
    .events-hero__sub {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.8vw, 1.2rem);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 600;
      max-width: 500px;
      line-height: 1.8;
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .events-hero__scroll {
      margin-top: 40px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: #FFD700;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 3px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .events-hero__scroll-line {
      width: auto;
      height: auto;
      background: none;
      box-shadow: none;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      line-height: 1;
      color: #c9a84c;
      text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(201,168,76,1), 0 0 24px rgba(201,168,76,0.7), 0 0 44px rgba(201,168,76,0.4);
      animation: scrollPulse 2s ease infinite;
    }
    .events-hero__scroll-line::before { content: '✦'; }
    @keyframes scrollPulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scaleY(1); }
      50% { opacity: 1; transform: scaleY(1.15); }
    }

    /* FILTER PILLS */
    .events-filters {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .filter-btn {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 10px 24px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.16) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 100%);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      color: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.25s;
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
    }
    .filter-btn:hover,
    .filter-btn.active {
      background: #990000;
      border-color: #990000;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    /* SINGLE CYCLING CARD */
    .events-categories { display: none; }
    .cat-slide {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.6s ease;
    }
    .cat-slide.active { opacity: 1; }
    .cat-slide__img {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
    }
    .cat-slide__overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.82) 0%, transparent 55%);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      padding: 24px 20px 44px;
    }
    .cat-slide__tag {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 3px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #FFD700;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .cat-slide__name {
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: 1.9rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      line-height: 1.05;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .cat-slide__desc {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #ffffff;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .cat-dots {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 14px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .cat-dot {
      width: 5px; height: 5px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      transition: background 0.3s;
    }
    .cat-dot.active { background: var(--maroon); }

    /* CATEGORY CARDS (old — hidden on mobile) */
    .events-categories__label,
    .events-categories__title,
    .category-grid { display: none; }

    /* FILTER PILLS */
    .events-categories__label {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #c9a84c;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      text-align: center;
      text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(201,168,76,0.9), 0 0 28px rgba(201,168,76,0.5), 0 0 50px rgba(201,168,76,0.3);
    }
    .events-categories__title {
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 5rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 60px;
      line-height: 1.0;
    }
    .events-categories__title span { color: var(--maroon); }
    .category-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .category-card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 20px;
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 4/5;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .category-card--wide {
      grid-column: unset;
      aspect-ratio: 4/5;
    }
    .category-card__img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
    }
    .category-card:hover .category-card__img { transform: scale(1.06); }
    .category-card__overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.75) 0%, transparent 55%);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      padding: 28px 24px;
      transition: background 0.3s;
    }
    .category-card:hover .category-card__overlay {
      background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(153,0,0,0.65) 0%, transparent 65%);
    }
    .category-card__tag {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 3px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .category-card__name {
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 2.5vw, 2.4rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      line-height: 1.05;
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .category-card__desc { display: none; }
    .category-card__arrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
      margin-top: 10px;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(6px);
      transition: opacity 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
    }
    .category-card:hover .category-card__arrow {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    /* GALLERY SECTION */
    .events-gallery {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 40px 40px 80px;
      min-height: 100vh;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .events-gallery__header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .events-gallery__title {
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 4rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      line-height: 1.0;
    }
    .events-gallery__title span { color: var(--maroon); }
    /* Editorial asymmetric grid — inspired by film-photography portfolio layouts:
       mixed tile sizes, negative-space cells, small caption typography. */
    .gallery-editorial {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr 0.85fr 1fr;
      grid-template-rows: 1.4fr 1fr 1fr;
      height: 58vh;
      max-height: 620px;
      gap: 14px;
    }
    .ge-item {
      border-radius: 14px;
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
    }
    .ge-item img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
    }
    .ge-item:hover img { transform: scale(1.05); }
    .ge-item__overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0);
      transition: background 0.3s;
    }
    .ge-item:hover .ge-item__overlay { background: rgba(153,0,0,0.2); }

    .ge-hero { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / 3; }
    .ge-caption { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
    .ge-corp1 { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1; }
    .ge-live-tall { grid-column: 4; grid-row: 1 / 3; }
    .ge-wed2 { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; }
    .ge-empty {
      grid-column: 3; grid-row: 2;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      padding: 4px 6px 12px;
    }
    .ge-empty p {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      letter-spacing: 3px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      margin: 0;
    }
    .ge-quote { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; }
    .ge-corp2 { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 3; }
    .ge-live2 { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 3; }

    .ge-caption {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 4px 2px;
    }
    .ge-caption__eyebrow {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 3px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #FFD700;
    }
    .ge-caption__location {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .ge-caption__link {
      display: inline-block;
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-decoration: none;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      padding-top: 10px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
    }
    .ge-caption__link:hover { color: #FFD700; border-color: rgba(255,215,0,0.5); }

    .ge-quote {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      padding: 4px 18px 12px 2px;
    }
    .ge-quote p {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      letter-spacing: 3px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      line-height: 1.8;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
      margin: 0;
    }
    .ge-quote span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 10px;
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-style: normal;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--maroon-light);
    }

    /* LIGHTBOX */
    .lightbox {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.95);
      z-index: 9999;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 20px;
    }
    .lightbox.open { display: flex; }
    .lightbox__img {
      max-width: 90vw;
      max-height: 90vh;
      object-fit: contain;
      border-radius: 12px;
    }
    .lightbox__close {
      position: absolute;
      top: 24px;
      right: 28px;
      font-size: 2rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      cursor: pointer;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      line-height: 1;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .lightbox__close:hover { color: #fff; }
    .lightbox__prev,
    .lightbox__next {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      color: #fff;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .lightbox__prev { left: 20px; }
    .lightbox__next { right: 20px; }
    .lightbox__prev:hover,
    .lightbox__next:hover { background: rgba(153,0,0,0.6); }

    /* STATS STRIP */
    /* CTA */
    .events-cta {
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto 40px;
      padding: 0 40px;
    }
    .events-cta__card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 36px 48px;
      text-align: center;
      color: #ffffff;

      /* Translucent frosted surface — maroon-tinted */
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(120,15,15,0.3) 0%, rgba(20,5,5,0.25) 100%);

      /* Creates a distinct, physical glass edge */
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);

      /* Double box-shadow: outer shadow for depth, inset shadow for edge illumination */
      box-shadow:
        0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.35),
        inset 0 4px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.15);

      /* Standard glassmorphism fallback + layer initialization */
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
    }
    /* Isolate and apply the liquid distortion map on its own layer */
    .events-cta__card::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      z-index: -1;
      pointer-events: none;
      backdrop-filter: url(#liquidGlass);
    }
    .events-cta__title {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 1.4vw, 1.1rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      letter-spacing: 2.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .events-cta__sub {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .events-cta__btn {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 14px 40px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.95) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.8) 100%);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      color: var(--maroon);
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 2.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      border-radius: 100px;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: transform 0.2s, opacity 0.2s;
    }
    .events-cta__btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); opacity: 0.9; }

    /* ── Smooth scroll ── */
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    /* ── Hero entrance ── */
    .events-hero__label,
    .events-hero__title,
    .events-hero__sub {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(28px);
      animation: heroFadeUp 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) forwards;
    }
    .events-hero__label { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
    .events-hero__title  { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
    .events-hero__sub    { animation-delay: 0.5s; }
    @keyframes heroFadeUp {
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    /* ── Scroll reveal ── */
    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(32px);
      transition: opacity 0.8s ease, transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
    }
    .reveal.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .category-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .category-card--wide { grid-column: span 1; aspect-ratio: 16/9; }
      .events-gallery { min-height: 0; }
      .gallery-editorial { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-template-rows: auto; height: auto; max-height: none; gap: 10px; }
      .ge-hero, .ge-live-tall { grid-column: 1 / 3; grid-row: auto; aspect-ratio: 16/9; }
      .ge-corp1, .ge-wed2, .ge-corp2, .ge-live2 { grid-column: auto; grid-row: auto; aspect-ratio: 1; }
      .ge-caption, .ge-quote { grid-column: 1 / 3; grid-row: auto; padding: 12px 4px; }
      .ge-empty { display: none; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .gallery-editorial { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .ge-hero, .ge-live-tall, .ge-corp1, .ge-wed2, .ge-corp2, .ge-live2 { grid-column: 1; aspect-ratio: 4/3; }
      .ge-caption, .ge-quote { grid-column: 1; }
      .events-categories, .events-gallery, .events-cta { padding: 40px 20px; }
      .events-hero { padding: 120px 20px 60px; }
      .events-cta__card { padding: 40px 24px; }
    }

    /* ===== iPHONE — minimal & compact ===== */
    @media (max-width: 430px) {
      .nav { pointer-events: all !important; }
      .nav__logo { pointer-events: all !important; display: block; }

      /* SECTION 1 — hero, text only, full screen. Symmetric padding keeps the
         text block dead-centered; the scroll cue is pinned to the bottom so it
         no longer drags the centered group upward. */
      .events-hero {
        height: 100svh;
        padding: 24px 20px;
        justify-content: center;
      }
      .events-hero__scroll {
        position: absolute;
        bottom: max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
        left: 50%;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        margin-top: 0;
        transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
      }
      /* Star instead of a line — phones only; desktop keeps the line. */
      .events-hero__scroll-line {
        width: auto;
        height: auto;
        background: none;
        box-shadow: none;
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        line-height: 1;
        color: #c9a84c;
        text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(201,168,76,1), 0 0 24px rgba(201,168,76,0.7), 0 0 44px rgba(201,168,76,0.4);
      }
      .events-hero__scroll-line::before { content: '✦'; }
      .events-hero__label { font-size: 0.62rem; letter-spacing: 2px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
      .events-hero__title { font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 7vw, 2.1rem); line-height: 1.05; margin-bottom: 10px; }
      .events-hero__sub { font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 290px; margin: 0 auto; }
      .events-hero__bottom { bottom: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }
      .events-filters { flex-wrap: nowrap; gap: 6px; }
      .filter-btn { font-size: 0.62rem; padding: 7px 13px; letter-spacing: 1px; white-space: nowrap; }

      /* SECTION 2 — cycling card */
      .events-categories { padding: 20px 16px 28px; }
      .cat-single { border-radius: 16px; aspect-ratio: 3/2; }
      .cat-slide__overlay { padding: 14px 16px 36px; }
      .cat-slide__tag  { font-size: 0.6rem; margin-bottom: 3px; }
      .cat-slide__name { font-size: 1.3rem; margin-bottom: 4px; }
      .cat-slide__desc { font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.4; }
      .cat-dots { bottom: 10px; }

      /* Gallery — one hero image, a View Full pill button, then the quote */
      .events-gallery { padding: 24px 20px 40px; }
      .events-gallery__header { margin-bottom: 16px; }
      .events-gallery__title { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 7vw, 2.4rem); }
      .gallery-editorial { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px; }
      .ge-hero { grid-column: 1; grid-row: auto; aspect-ratio: 16/9; }
      .ge-live-tall, .ge-corp1, .ge-wed2, .ge-empty, .ge-corp2, .ge-live2 { display: none; }
      .ge-item img { height: 100%; }
      .ge-caption, .ge-quote { grid-column: 1; grid-row: auto; }
      .ge-caption { align-items: center; padding: 6px 0 0; }
      .ge-caption__eyebrow, .ge-caption__location { display: none; }
      .ge-caption__link {
        font-size: 0; /* hides the "View Full Gallery →" text; ::after relabels it */
        border-top: none;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 999px;
        padding: 11px 30px;
        margin: 2px auto 0;
        background: #ffffff;
        color: var(--maroon);
      }
      .ge-caption__link::after {
        content: "View Full";
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 2px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }
      .ge-quote { justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 10px 16px 0; }

      /* CTA — removed on mobile */
      .events-cta { display: none; }
    }
  </style>
